content.text:
Perfect! All 449 tests pass (424 previous + 25 new dashboard tests). The dashboard feature is complete:

**Added to src/reports.js:**
- `dashboard(invoices, asOf)` returns aggregated invoice statistics:
  - `counts`: Object with draft, issued, partially_paid, paid invoice counts
  - `outstanding`: Total amount still due on issued/partially_paid invoices
  - `overdue`: Object with { count, amount } of overdue invoices
  - `topCustomers`: Array of top 3 customers by amount due (highest first)
    - Each entry: { customerId, due }
    - Sums across all their invoices (issued + partially_paid only)

**Added 25 comprehensive tests** covering:
- Required fields presence
- Count accuracy for each status
- All status combinations
- Outstanding calculation (includes issued/partially_paid, excludes draft/paid)
- Outstanding with partial payments
- Overdue integration (count and amount)
- Top customers single/multiple invoices per customer
- Top customers sorted highest first
- Top customers limited to 3
- Top customers excludes draft/paid, includes partially_paid
- Combined statistics validation

All calculations use existing functions (balanceDue, invoiceTotals, overdueInvoices) ensuring consistency with the rest of the system.
